description_en: Queries nodes based on the output of the nodes
description_zh: 根据节点的输出结果精确查询目标节点
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-nodes-by-output --project-env PROD --outputs aaaaa.1231412_out,bbbb.12313123_out --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNodesByOutput

parameters.help_en: The environment of Operation Center. Valid values: PROD and DEV. The value PROD indicates the production environment, and the value DEV indicates the development environment
parameters.help_zh: 调度运维中心的环境标识，PROD表示生产环境，DEV表示开发环境
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en: The output name of the node. You can specify multiple output names. Separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 节点的输出名称。支持配置多个输出名称，配置多个名称时请使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: outputs

Data.description_zh: 返回的目标节点信息列表

NodeList.description_en: The information about the nodes returned
NodeList.description_zh: input和output对应的节点信息列表

Connection.description_en: The name of the data source

DqcDescription.description_en: The table and partition filter expression in Data Quality that are associated with the node

DqcType.description_en: Indicates whether the node is associated with a monitoring rule in Data Quality. Valid values: 0 and 1. The value 0 indicates that the node is associated with a monitoring rule in Data Quality. The value 1 indicates that the node is not associated with a monitoring rule in Data Quality
DqcType.description_zh: DQC类型，0表示有关联dqc，1表示没有关联dqc

FileType.description_en:
The node type. Valid values:

6 (Shell), 10 (ODPS SQL), 11 (ODPS MR), 23 (Data Integration), 24 (ODPS Script), 99 (zero load), 221 (PyODPS 2), 225 (ODPS Spark), 227 (EMR Hive), 228 (EMR Spark), 229 (EMR Spark SQL), 230 (EMR MR), 239 (OSS object inspection), 257 (EMR Shell), 258 (EMR Spark Shell), 259 (EMR Presto), 260 (EMR Impala), 900 (real-time synchronization), 1089 (cross-tenant collaboration), 1091 (Hologres development), 1093 (Hologres SQL), 1100 (assignment), and 1221 (PyODPS 3)
FileType.description_zh: 文件类型。不同文件类型其代码不同，详情请参见[DataWorks节点合集]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/600169.html）

ParamValues.description_en: The scheduling parameters of the node

Priority.description_en: The priority of the node. Valid values: 1, 3, 5, 7, and 8. A greater value indicates a higher priority. Default value: 1
Priority.description_zh: 节点运行的优先级，取值分为1、3、5、7和8。取值越大，优先级越高。默认优先级为1

ProgramType.description_en: The node type. This parameter is deprecated. For more information about node types, see valid values of the FileType parameter
ProgramType.description_zh: 节点的类型。该参数已废弃，节点类型请参考FileType

RelatedFlowId.description_en: The ID of the workflow to which the node belongs

RepeatInterval.description_en: The interval at which the node is rerun after the node fails to run
RepeatInterval.description_zh: 节点运行出错后重新调度的频率

Repeatability.description_en: Indicates whether the node can be rerun

ResGroupName.description_en: The name of the resource group

SchedulerType.description_en:
The scheduling type of the node. Valid values:

NORMAL: The node is an auto triggered node. The scheduling system regularly runs the node.
MANUAL: The node is a manually triggered node. The scheduling system does not regularly run the node.
PAUSE: The node is a frozen node. The scheduling system regularly runs the node but sets the status of the node to failed when the scheduling system starts to run the node.
SKIP: The node is a dry-run node. The scheduling system regularly runs the node but sets the status of the node to successful when the scheduling system starts to run the node
SchedulerType.description_zh:
节点任务的调度类型，取值如下：
NORMAL：正常调度任务。该任务被日常调度。
MANUAL：手动任务。该任务不会被日常调度。
PAUSE：冻结任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为失败状态。
SKIP：空跑任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为成功状态

Output.description_en: The output name of the current node

RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
